resources.string:
Sweep (\"Hidden Camera & Bug Detector\") checks the room you are in for hidden cameras, trackers and other devices. This policy explains what the app does with your data.
1. Everything stays on your phone All scans run on your device. Scan results, reports and checklist progress are saved only on your phone. We do not have servers that receive them, and we cannot see them.
2. What we do not collect We do not collect your name, email, contacts, photos, location or any scan results. The app has no ads, no analytics and no tracking SDKs.
3. Permissions and why we ask • Camera: to show the live view in the lens finder. Pictures are not saved or sent anywhere. • Wi-Fi / network: to list devices on the Wi-Fi you are connected to and check if any of them look like cameras. This only talks to devices on your local network. • Bluetooth and location: Android requires the location permission to scan for nearby Bluetooth devices such as AirTags. The app never reads your GPS position. • Magnetic sensor: to measure magnetic fields near electronics. No permission is needed. You can turn off any permission in your phone settings. The other tools keep working.
4. Purchases Sweep Pro subscriptions are handled by Google Play. We do not see or store your payment details. Google\'s privacy policy applies to the payment: https://policies.google.com/privacy
5. Ratings and feedback If you rate the app, Google Play handles it. If you send feedback by email, we use your email only to answer you.
6. Children The app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from them.
7. Changes If this policy changes, the new version will be in the app with a new date.
8. Contact Questions? Email us at the address below.
